nonfork_outside_upstream_and_sync.body:
feat(skills): add sc-crash-recovery for post-crash work-state diagnosis

Fans parallel subagents across pipeline artifacts, recent Claude Code session
logs, serena memory, git status, and auggie semantic sweeps to produce a
structured "where was I, what's in-flight, what to resume" report.

Built per Developer Guide patterns: allowed-tools safety boundary, refs/ for
lazy-loaded reference material, STOP-on-invalid-input contract, and explicit
tool-failure fallback matrix. Read-only diagnosis — proposes resume commands
but never executes them.

Pipeline knowledge covers PRD, TDD, spec/research, roadmap, tasklist, sprint,
and MDTM task layouts with their canonical resume idioms.

Supports single-project mode (default, current cwd) and fleet sweep across
all /config/workspace/ projects with --all flag.

upstream_keyword_nonupstream.name: Ryan wiancko
upstream_keyword_nonupstream.subject: fix(mcp): restore registration after failed remove; re-acquire after partial upstream install
upstream_keyword_nonupstream.body:
fix(mcp): restore registration after failed remove; re-acquire after partial upstream install

- install_mcp: when `claude mcp remove` fails (it may have persisted the
  deletion before exiting nonzero or timing out), restore the captured
  previous user entry instead of reporting "no replacement was attempted".
  Restoration only re-adds our own captured entry; a third party's entry is
  never removed. Reports "intact" or "restoration failed" distinctly.
- install_codebase_memory: write a private pending marker before the upstream
  install stage and clear it only after the acquisition receipt is written.
  A canonical binary with the marker is re-acquired instead of reused, so a
  retry after a partial upstream run completes setup and records ownership.
  Pre-existing/manual and external binaries are still reused without
  adoption; an untrusted marker fails closed.
- Regression tests for both, including persist-then-fail removes and
  place-then-fail upstream runs.

Addresses Augment review on PR #275.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

upstream_keyword_nonupstream.body:
fix(prd): align gates.py research-notes schema with upstream prompt (#62)

The PRD pipeline gate hard-coded a 7-name section list that did not match
what the prompt instructs the agent to emit, causing every
`superclaude prd run` invocation to halt at the step-4 gate. The upstream
skill at src/superclaude/skills/prd/SKILL.md is the source of truth for
the EXISTING_FILES schema; the gate's list was a port-time fabrication.

Edits:
- gates.py: rewrite _RESEARCH_REQUIRED_SECTIONS to the EXISTING_FILES
  schema (EXISTING_FILES, PATTERNS_AND_CONVENTIONS, FEATURE_ANALYSIS,
  RECOMMENDED_OUTPUTS, SUGGESTED_PHASES, TEMPLATE_NOTES,
  AMBIGUITIES_FOR_USER).
- gates.py: widen _check_suggested_phases_detail regex \s+ -> [\s_]+ so
  the underscore form `## SUGGESTED_PHASES` matches in addition to the
  space forms.
- test_gates.py: rewrite TestCheckResearchNotesSections fixture in
  lockstep with the new schema.
- test_e2e.py: rewrite the research-notes branch of _make_passing_output
  so the 5 e2e scenarios that feed mock subprocess output through the
  real gate continue to pass.
- test_research_notes_roundtrip.py: new integration test that wires
  build_research_notes_prompt() output through both check functions to
  prevent future schema drift.

Verification: focused pytest 15/15, full PRD suite 68/68, ruff clean on
all four edited files. The halted TUIBBS V1 run resumes via
`superclaude prd resume sufficiency-review` with $0 re-cost.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

upstream_keyword_nonupstream.body:
feat(v1.05): add core framework file installation to superclaude install

Previously, `superclaude install` only copied slash commands to
~/.claude/commands/sc/. Core framework files (CLAUDE.md, PERSONAS.md,
ORCHESTRATOR.md, etc.) had no distribution mechanism.

- Create install_core.py with install/list/verify functions for core files
- Update CLI install command to copy core files to ~/.claude/ before commands
- Update CLI update command to also refresh core framework files
- Add --list mode showing both core files and slash commands
- Copy all 6 compressed v1.05 core files to src/superclaude/core/
- Update install.sh messaging for combined framework + commands install

This ensures fresh installs get the 50.5% token reduction from v1.05.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
